summary: Tested DGII Reports feature (IR-3, IR-4, TSS Autodeterminación, TSS Novedades). Backend: 14/14 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Fixed bug where periods weren't loading due to API response format mismatch.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED - Frontend expected response.data.periods but API returns array directly
integration_issues.resolution: Updated fetchPeriods to handle both array and object response formats

critical_code_review_comments: IR-4 endpoint correctly generates Excel with employee-level ISR retention details
IR-3 endpoint generates summary report for DGII declaration
TSS Autodeterminación and Novedades endpoints generate valid XLS files
All export endpoints require authentication and return 404 for non-existent periods
DGIIReportsPage correctly displays 4 report types with download buttons
Period selector now auto-selects most recent paid/closed period
create_ir4_report function in tss_generator.py properly calculates totals and generates 2-sheet Excel
seed_data_creation: Used existing payroll periods from previous tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: DGII Reports feature fully tested. Key findings: 1) All 4 export endpoints work correctly (IR-3, IR-4, TSS Autodeterminación, TSS Novedades), 2) Fixed frontend bug in DGIIReportsPage.jsx where periods weren't loading - API returns array directly but frontend expected {periods: []}, 3) All exports generate valid XLS files with correct headers, 4) Period selector now shows all available periods and auto-selects paid/closed periods, 5) Download buttons are enabled when a period is selected.

ir4_export_endpoint.details: GET /api/payroll-v2/periods/{id}/export/ir4 returns valid XLS with employee ISR details

ir3_export_endpoint.details: GET /api/payroll-v2/periods/{id}/export/ir3 returns valid XLS with retention summary

dgii_reports_page_ui.details: Page loads correctly, shows 4 report types, period selector works

period_selector.details: Fixed API response format handling - now correctly loads and displays periods

bug_fixed.issue: Frontend expected response.data.periods but API returns array directly
bug_fixed.fix: Changed to handle both formats: Array.isArray(response.data) ? response.data : (response.data.periods || [])

mocked_integrations.all_apis: REAL - No mocked APIs, all endpoints are real
